title: Imp Jar & Zeus Bolt White Chocolate Mocha 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: White Chocolate Mocha by Imp Jar and Zeus Juice encapsulates the indulgent pleasure of a coffee shop favourite. This e-liquid combines the silky smoothness of white chocolate with the robust depth of mocha, creating a vape experience that's rich in flavour and comfort. It's a sophisticated blend that perfectly balances the sweetness of chocolate with the complexity of coffee, ideal for any time of the day. This e-liquid is a testament to simple, perfected pleasures, making it a delightful treat at any time. Joining forces, Imp Jar's balanced 50/50 e-liquids and Zeus Juice's exceptional flavour craftsmanship result in a versatile e-liquid suitable for various vaping devices. Whether you prefer pod systems or starter kits, this 50PG/50VG blend offers an ideal vaping experience with ample flavour and cloud production. Each 60ml shortfill bottle contains 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, plus 10ml space for a nicotine shot. Adding a 10ml, 18mg nicotine shot creates 60ml of 3mg e-liquid, allowing for personalized nicotine strength. It's a perfect option for those seeking both high-quality flavour and the flexibility to adjust nicotine content.
